pages.title: Hyper Melder
pages.text: Give power to the Hyper Melder by charging the Hyper Generators and keeping them charged until all 4 Melders are glowing. Throw in 10 Colvinite Power Banks and 20 Electron Recyclers to recieve an Clovinite Power Hub.

pages.title: Hyper Generator
pages.text: Use External Colvinite Battery on all 10 Generators and keep them active by adding more. A mob will spawn turning them off. Turn them back on until the Melder is active!
